nodes.text: It's a pleasant Monday evening, and Kim is busy working her late shift at Ms. Rose's Bakery.

nodes.text: Let's just see what I've made here... Snickerdoodles, peanut butter brownies, and a couple oatmeal raisin crunch bars! I love working at the bakery!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But... But... But I don't have 200 spare dollars! I need every dollar my shop earns just to get by!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Here's da deal. I've got to go away for ten days... I'm going out to a retreat in da desert, Future Business Leaders of America, dat sort of thing.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: When I come back, youse better have dat money for me... Or da only thing dat'll be baking around here is dis shop!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Yes, I got that.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Lumbar
nodes.text: Ten days!

nodes.text: Ms. Rose...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose

nodes.text: These poor old bones just can't keep up with the times.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why don't we call the cops?
